x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request POST \
  --url 'https://omnimux.ai/api/influencer/v1/characters' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer <user-access-token>' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"request_id":"creator-character-0001","tier":"normal","brief":"A friendly adult character","selection":{"gender":["female"]}}'

accessToken.description: Scoped OmniMux personal credential. Each operation lists its exact influencer_creation grant. No automatic expansion for old or legacy tokens. Do not use an sk- relay key. Website sessions are validated separately by the existing account authentication.

Selection.description: Map category IDs to ordered option-ID arrays from options.taxonomy. This is an object, not a flat array. Unknown categories/options and incompatible combinations are rejected; tier visibility and existing selection normalization apply.

content_url.description: Short-lived signed artifact URL. Re-read the artifact endpoint if it expires. Never send the account credential to this URL or its storage redirects.

duration_sec.description: Integer generation duration in seconds derived by the server from the reference video; fractional seconds may be rounded. Not a creation input, the exact reference duration, or a measurement of the finished video.

request_id.description: Client recovery ID; may be empty for earlier website tasks without a CLI receipt. Distinct from HTTP tracing request IDs.

raw_status.description: Native task status; use normalized status for automation.

artifact_status.description: ready requires succeeded plus usable artifacts. An accepted request or empty artifact list is not a delivered result.

recovery_expires_at.description: Unix seconds. Zero while active or before a terminal deadline is established. Recovery lasts seven days after completion; expiry never permits request-ID reuse.

replayed.description: Returned by creation, request recovery and task/artifact detail. Character projections need not include this field.

raw_quota.description: Known native quota record, not credits: raw_quota / 500000 = USD. Omitted if no positive known amount exists.

credits.description: Known raw_quota / 50000. Not an upfront quote or proof of a final refund.

quota_status.description: reconciling on failed tasks does not confirm a completed refund.

fail_reason.description: Public failure reason, when available; inspect with status. Never infer successful refund from a failure message.

fail_reason.description: Public failure reason, when available; inspect with status. Never infer successful refund from a failure message.

multiviews.description: Owned related multiview tasks, including unfinished and failed tasks.

prompt_map.description: Embedded prompt metadata; choose input IDs from categories rather than sending this object.

creation_enabled.description: False disables new CLI creations, not reads or identical accepted replays. True alone does not establish compatible route availability.

request_id.description: Required, case-sensitive account-scoped recovery key. Repeating the same intent returns the original task; changed content returns 409.

tier.description: normal: ordinary person; freak: stylized person; total: exaggerated person; cats/dogs: anthropomorphic animal.

brief.description: Appearance and wardrobe guidance; the fixed dual-view composition is preserved. For human types provide at least one valid option, a brief, or a style image.

image_url.description: Optional style-reference image. JPEG/PNG/WebP, at most 5 MiB. It must be publicly fetchable and passes the existing image safety checks.

character_task_id.description: Successful owned original character. Its image is prepended to image_urls as the primary subject. Multiview outputs cannot be used as this original-character ID.

image_urls.description: Ordered subject/support images. With character_task_id, at most 29 supplemental images. Otherwise at least one image is required, and image_urls[0] is the primary subject. Total: 1–30.

video_url.description: Exactly one reference source: this public HTTPS clip or video_task_id. Server inspects actual media; no client duration input.

video_task_id.description: Owned successful character-video task used as the reference clip; exclusive with video_url.

aspect_ratio.description: 480p: 16:9, 9:16, 3:4. 720p: 16:9, 9:16. Motion: explicit value wins, otherwise follow a supported source ratio, otherwise 9:16. Replace: keep the supported source ratio and reject a conflicting explicit value.

prompt.description: Optional compatible performance/scene guidance. Reference audio and primary character identity/species remain part of the generation contract.

NativePaymentRequired.description: 402 is native execution billing semantics, not a synchronous response emitted by current queue acceptance.

example.message: insufficient account allowance
